Excellent sculpting, terrific paint choices (and translucent parts), huge, well-articulated and all-around fun.
The deco on this figure is jaw-dropping...the red paint on his skirt is metallic with little flecks of sparkles in it.
The use of colored translucent plastic on this figure is also a huge win. The flaming head with painted on opaque face looks ridiculously cool.

The articulation on Dormammu is still solid, and features a ball-jointed head and hips, ab crunch, swivel waist and biceps, ball-hinge shoulders and wrists, hinge elbows, double-jointed knees, swivel thighs and boots and ankle rockers.
I flipping love the repainted flaming skulls Dormammu comes with this time out!

The SDCC variant is more cream-colored and the sash is a darker green compared to the white bone paint and olive green sash on the DBAF variant.
The SDCC version also has skull facepaint, green eyes, and a green symbol on the forehead, compared to the white eyes, eyeshadow, and white symbol on the DBAF variant.
The capes are both different, with the DBAF variant having a tattered cape and the SDCC variant having a more regal cape with added decoration in the front.
